[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd proof

# Each package below passes the linter and the race detector and fails
# only under the monitor. No memory is raced, so every fault is ordering
# or timing only. Every wait is bounded; the script ends in seconds.

# --- conc::lock_order_inversion ---
# Two Locked values taken in opposite orders by two code paths that run
# one after the other in the test: no deadlock happened in this run.
logos lint ./order
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./order
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '
! logos conc test -count=1 ./order
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::lock_order_inversion\] two goroutines take the same two Locked values in opposite orders; when both run at once, each waits for the other'

# --- conc::lock_held_long ---
# A slow call inside a WithLock callback while another goroutine waits.
logos lint ./hold
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./hold
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '
! logos conc test -hold=50ms -count=1 ./hold
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::lock_held_long\] a goroutine held a Locked value for .* while another goroutine waited for it; the limit is 50ms'

# --- conc::group_child_stalled ---
# A child that ignores its context still sleeps after the group fails.
logos lint ./stall
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./stall
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./stall
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\] a group child did not return within 200ms after its group was cancelled; the group cannot join before the child returns'

# --- conc::group_unbounded ---
# A group without a limit runs 10000 children at one time.
logos lint ./growth
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./growth
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '
! logos conc test -count=1 ./growth
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::group_unbounded\] a group without a limit runs 10000 children at one time; the count follows the work the program gives the group'

# --- conc::goroutine_leak ---
# A goroutine of a Go helper package waits on a channel nothing holds,
# as in logos_conc_leak.txt. The LoGOs caller only starts it and sleeps.
logos lint ./leak
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./leak
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '
! logos conc test -count=1 ./leak
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::goroutine_leak\] a goroutine waits, and no goroutine that can run reaches what it waits for; it never ends'

# --- schedule fault under -shake ---
# One thread only: the fault is the order the spawns give, and stealing
# the second child onto another thread would hide it.
env GOMAXPROCS=1

logos lint ./sched
! stderr .
# Under -race the runnext slot is randomized and the spawn order does
# not hold, so this step checks only that both children ran with no race.
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 -run TestBothRan ./sched
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# Without a shake the spawn order holds and the monitor stays silent.
logos conc test -count=1 ./sched
stdout '^ok '
! stderr .

# With seed 1 the lock taker yields and the direct child sends first,
# so the test fails. The command prints the seed that replays it.
! logos conc test -shake=1 -count=1 ./sched
stdout 'order = '
stderr 'shake seed 1'

-- proofblocks/blocks/blocks.go --
package blocks

func Subscribe() {
	updates := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		<-updates
	}()
}
-- proof/order/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var (
	checking sync.Locked[account]
	savings  sync.Locked[account]
)

func save(amount int) error {
	checking.WithLock(from => {
		savings.WithLock(to => {
			from.balance -= amount
			to.balance += amount
		})
	})
	return nil
}

func spend(amount int) error {
	savings.WithLock(from => {
		checking.WithLock(to => {
			from.balance -= amount
			to.balance += amount
		})
	})
	return nil
}

func transfers(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go save(10)
	}
	go group (ctx) {
		go spend(4)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := transfers(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fmt.Println("transfers done")
}
-- proof/order/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestTransfers(t *testing.T) {
	if err := transfers(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
-- proof/hold/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var ledger sync.Locked[account]

func audit() error {
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
		a.balance += 10
	})
	return nil
}

func pay() error {
	time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		a.balance--
	})
	return nil
}

func settle(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	go group (ctx) {
		go audit()
		go pay()
	}
	balance := 0
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		balance = a.balance
	})
	return balance, nil
}

func main() {
	balance, err := settle(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("balance", balance)
}
-- proof/hold/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestSettle(t *testing.T) {
	balance, err := settle(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if balance != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("balance = %d, want 9", balance)
	}
}
-- proof/stall/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow() error {
	time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow()
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- proof/stall/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- proof/growth/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

func herd(ctx context.Context) error {
	var started sync.WaitGroup
	go group (ctx) {
		for range 10000 {
			started.Add(1)
			go {
				started.Done()
				time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
			}
		}
		started.Wait()
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := herd(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("herd done")
}
-- proof/growth/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestHerd(t *testing.T) {
	if err := herd(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

}

-- proof/sched/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"logos/sync"
)

type box struct{ n int }

var gate sync.Locked[box]

func locked(first chan string) error {
	gate.WithLock(b => {
		b.n++
	})
	gate.WithLock(b => {
		b.n++
	})
	select {
	case first <- "locked":
	default:
	}
	return nil
}

func direct(first chan string) error {
	select {
	case first <- "direct":
	default:
	}
	return nil
}

func order(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	first := make(chan string, 2)
	go group (ctx) {
		go direct(first)
		go locked(first)
	}
	a := <-first
	b := <-first
	return a + "," + b, nil
}

func main() {
	got, err := order(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(got)
	if got != "locked,direct" {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}
-- proof/sched/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestOrder(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := order(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if got != "locked,direct" {
		t.Fatalf("order = %q, want %q", got, "locked,direct")
	}
}

func TestBothRan(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := order(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if got != "locked,direct" && got != "direct,locked" {
		t.Fatalf("order = %q, want both children to send", got)
	}
}
